def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # fix island case variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # body_mass_g: text -> numeric, strip commas, fix milligram-scale values to grams
    mass = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
    mass = pd.to_numeric(mass, errors='coerce')
    mass = mass.where(mass <= 6500, mass / 1000)  # 3650000 mg -> 3650 g
    df['body_mass_g'] = mass
    # flipper_length_mm and year: text -> numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    d = d[d['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]
    grouped = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
